description: Synthetic GPU1 TP1 tile score/mask/selection/native pack plus direct K8/V4 attention A/B; not serving. Warmups 2, 6 alternating synchronized wall-time samples. Indexer 4x128; attention 24 Q/4 KV, 128 rows, 512 pooled blocks, K=2048 tokens plus own block. No checkpoint weights.
device: Intel Arc Pro B60, physical GPU1, TP1

measurements.boundary: score+mask+native pack+direct quantized attention; synthetic TP1; excludes cache writes, gather, projection, serving

limitations: Calls actual score, native selector/packer, prefix helper and direct attention, but not surrounding try_sparse_forward dispatch; excludes pool gather, projection, sidecar writes, and serving. GPU1 cleanup and no-swap checks passed. All pooled blocks valid and scores finite in this synthetic case; invalid or non-finite score behavior and whole-runtime parity were not qualified.
baseline_runtime_tests: 3 failures and 9 passes, identical to clean base in same CPU container; prefix test passes.
